Be mindful: radmanso drawers will be placed on the wall opposite the bed. show me layout in browser. Use amazon only for searches. Don't want it. Also make sure rug is low pile ,thin with rubber backing, similar to the one we bought for living room, preferably, same brand". The room as it was that morning is l. Andrew's reading, 2026-11-10: "for the right side of the bed, it's about 2 feet to the heater from the lg, make sure I can keep the 9 foot wide rug evenly fit": the bed's window side (the right as you lie in it) is about 24" from its leg to the heater, against the 27 1/4" drawn. The rug stays centered on the bed, 14 7/16" past each side, as he asks, so its window-side edge ends about 9 1/2" short of the heater's face: a flat 0.14" rug lying clear of the heater, not under it or against its bottom gap, which F-33's 12" for bedding and upholstery doesn't govern. If the bed really stands 3 1/4" nearer the window than drawn, its bathroom side is about 26 7/8" (wider than the 23 5/8" drawn) and a 21 1/4" nightstand beside it at the window end would be about 2 3/4" off the heater's face, under F-33's 6": measure that side before the rug goes down.
